source: 仅本次运行生效；重新启动后恢复风险确认。
en: Applies to this session only. Restarting restores risk confirmations.

source: 将跳过敏感关闭的 5 秒倒计时和强制关闭二次确认。首次操作确认与系统核心保护仍保留。
en: Skips the 5-second sensitive-close countdown and second force-close confirmations. Initial action confirmation and critical system protection remain enabled.

source: 关闭部分程序可能导致桌面失效、未保存数据丢失，甚至系统崩溃。请先保存所有工作。
en: Closing some programs may disable the desktop, lose unsaved data, or even crash the system. Save all your work first.

source: 二次风险确认已关闭。结束部分程序可能丢失数据、使桌面失效，甚至导致系统崩溃。
en: Second risk confirmations are off. Closing some programs may lose data, disable the desktop, or even crash the system.

source: 此操作仅针对下列进程。无视风险模式已跳过二次确认。
en: Only the process below will be affected. Ignore risks mode skips the second confirmation.

source: Steam 会先正常退出，最多等待 30 秒。无视风险模式下，勾选强制结束后将跳过再次确认，可能丢失未保存或未同步的数据。
en: Steam first gets up to 30 seconds to exit normally. In ignore risks mode, choosing force close skips the second confirmation and may lose unsaved or unsynced data.
